text:
Alex Chen: Quick Q — we're planning to enable audit_trace_mode for retention logs in a canary next week. Need to lock down PII-scrub + KMS/HSM fallback guardrails. Who wants to own the rollout?

Priya Nair: I can own rollout for Hosted + Dedicated. Canary audience = 5% internal + beta customers. Security needs to sign off on KMS fallback path though.

Jordan Li: Note for Private: many customers won't have HSM. Fallback will be customer-managed KMS; need to confirm key rotation and iam bindings. Also propose retention_grace_days=30 during canary to avoid accidental deletes.

Alex Chen: example flag payload we'll push to LaunchDarkly/flags service:
```json
{
  "flag": "audit_trace_mode",
  "enabled": true,
  "canary": {
    "percent": 5,
    "segments": ["internal-engineering", "beta-customers"]
  },
  "guardrails": {
    "pii_scrub": "v2",
    "kms_mode": "prefer-hsm, fallback-kms",
    "retention_grace_days": 30
  }
}
```

Samir Patel: FYI enabling this increases structured log volume ~3x for trace events. Ops — do we have ingestion headroom? @Tess Gomez

Tess Gomez: We have a temporary throttle quota we can enable for the canary window. Also please ensure event prefixing toggled off for these traces to avoid double-ingest. I'll add a small alert for log lag > 20s.

security-bot: Policy check — pii_scrub_v2 must be enabled for any audit_trace_mode flip. If not present, blocking flag rollout. See policy-ID: SEC-P-042.

Priya Nair: Confirmed — pii_scrub_v2 will be set true in the canary. I'll also run a small corpus of sample payloads through the scrubber and post results. PR incoming: https://git.redwood/infra/flags/pulls/4532

Alex Chen: Can someone ping CS to notify beta customers and Eng-Infra for infra prep? Also would like a 30-min rollout window Mon 09:00 PST. @Jordan Li can you schedule LaunchDarkly rule and share segment ids?

Jordan Li: sgtm. Created canary segments in LD: internal-engineering (seg-1102), beta-1 (seg-2203). Will attach them to the flag and link once done.

Samir Patel: Quick CR ping @Priya — small naming nit on metrics (use redwood.audit.trace.* instead of trace.audit.*).

Priya Nair: On it, will update and review by EOD. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by Priya Nair for 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z. Deploy ID: dep-7890.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — leaving this thread as the coordination point. I'll post a final checklist with signoffs tomorrow.

Tess Gomez: Added temporary alert doc to #eng-oncall runbook. Link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/log-lag-canary

Jordan Li: Linked PR and LD rule in the flag ticket. Will monitor and rollback on any policy/billing alerts.

security-bot: Reminder: post-canary audit required — submit SEC-AUDIT ticket within 48h of canary end.

Priya Nair: Noted. I'll create the audit ticket and assign to @Alex Chen and @Jordan Li.
